metadata.name: Strategy
metadata.description: MSTR tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in Strategy Inc (formerly MicroStrategy Incorporated). Strategy is a major corporate holder of Bitcoin as part of its treasury strategy.

metadata.name: ASML
metadata.description: ASML tracks the value of 1 American Depositary Receipt of ASML Holding N.V. ASML is a leading semiconductor equipment company, best known for its photolithography systems used by chipmakers to manufacture advanced integrated circuits.

metadata.name: CoreWeave
metadata.description: CRWV-PERP tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in CoreWeave, Inc. CoreWeave provides GPU cloud infrastructure optimized for AI and high-performance computing workloads.

metadata.name: Tesla
metadata.description: TSLA-PERP tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in Tesla, Inc. (NASDAQ: TSLA) Tesla designs and manufactures electric vehicles, battery energy storage systems, and solar products. The company is a global leader in EV production and autonomous driving technology.

metadata.name: Intel
metadata.description: INTC-PERP tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in Intel Corporation. Intel designs and manufactures semiconductors and computing platforms. The company produces CPUs and related hardware for personal computers, servers, and data centers.

metadata.name: Nebius
metadata.description: NBIS references 1 Nebius Group N.V. Class A ordinary share (Nasdaq: NBIS), quoted in USD. Nebius provides GPU-based cloud and AI infrastructure.

metadata.name: QQQ
metadata.description: Provides exposure to 100 of the largest non-financial companies listed on U.S. exchanges, with a concentration in technology, communications, and high-growth sectors.

metadata.name: Marvell Technology, Inc.
metadata.description: MRVL references 1 share of Marvell Technology, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: MRVL), quoted in USD. Marvell develops semiconductors for data infrastructure, networking, storage, and computing.

metadata.name: Circle Internet Group
metadata.description: CRCL tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in Circle Internet Group, Inc. Circle issues and manages USDC, a U.S. dollar-backed stablecoin, and provides digital asset infrastructure for payments and financial services.

metadata.name: Dell Technologies
metadata.description: DELL references 1 share of Dell Technologies Inc. Class C common stock (NYSE: DELL), quoted in USD. Dell provides computers, servers, storage, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.

metadata.name: Robinhood
metadata.description: HOOD tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in Robinhood Markets, Inc. Robinhood operates a retail brokerage platform offering commission-free trading in equities, options, and cryptocurrencies to individual investors.

metadata.name: IREN Limited
metadata.description: IREN references 1 IREN Limited ordinary share (Nasdaq: IREN), quoted in USD. IREN develops and operates data centers supporting AI cloud computing.

metadata.name: AMD
metadata.description: AMD-PERP tracks the price of 1 share of common stock in Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. AMD designs high-performance processors and graphics chips used in PCs, gaming consoles, data centers, and AI workloads.

metadata.name: Meta
metadata.description: META-PERP tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in Meta Platforms, Inc. Meta operates social media and digital advertising platforms including Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, and invests in virtual reality and metaverse technologies.

metadata.name: SpaceX
metadata.description: SPCX-PERP tracks the price of 1 share of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SPCX) common stock. This is a perpetual futures contract cash-settled against the real-time market price of SPCX. SpaceX designs, manufactures, and launches rockets and spacecraft, operates Starlink, a global broadband satellite network and develops Grok, a frontier AI model, through its vertically integrated space, connectivity, and AI platform.

metadata.name: Sandisk
metadata.description: SNDK-PERP tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in Sandisk Corporation. Sandisk develops and manufactures flash memory storage solutions used in consumer electronics, enterprise systems, and data infrastructure.

metadata.name: Coinbase
metadata.description: COIN tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in Coinbase Global, Inc. Coinbase operates a cryptocurrency exchange providing trading, custody, and digital asset infrastructure.

metadata.name: Microsoft
metadata.description: MSFT-PERP tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in Microsoft Corporation. Microsoft develops software, cloud computing services, and hardware. Its products include Windows, Office, Azure cloud infrastructure, and enterprise software solutions.

metadata.name: Alibaba
metadata.description: BABA references 1 Alibaba Group Holding Limited ADS (NYSE: BABA), representing 8 ordinary shares (HKEX: 9988), quoted in USD. Alibaba operates commerce, cloud-computing, and logistics businesses.

metadata.name: CrowdStrike Holdings
metadata.description: CRWD references 1 share of CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: CRWD), quoted in USD. CrowdStrike provides cloud-native cybersecurity software through its Falcon platform for endpoint, identity, cloud, and data protection.

metadata.name: Moderna
metadata.description: MRNA references 1 share of Moderna, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: MRNA), quoted in USD. Moderna develops messenger RNA (mRNA) medicines, including infectious-disease vaccines and oncology therapeutics.

metadata.name: Applied Materials
metadata.description: AMAT references 1 share of Applied Materials, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: AMAT), quoted in USD. Applied Materials provides equipment and services for semiconductor and display manufacturing.

metadata.name: Cerebras
metadata.description: CBRS tracks the value of 1 share of Class A common stock in Cerebras Systems Inc. Cerebras develops AI chips, supercomputing systems, and cloud infrastructure designed to power large-scale artificial intelligence workloads.

metadata.name: ARM
metadata.description: ARM tracks the value of 1 American depositary share of Arm Holdings plc. Arm designs and licenses CPU and GPU architectures and processor IP that power most of the world's smartphones, along with a growing range of data-center, automotive, and embedded devices.

metadata.name: Eli Lilly and Company
metadata.description: LLY references 1 share of Eli Lilly and Company common stock (NYSE: LLY), quoted in USD. Eli Lilly develops and manufactures pharmaceutical products.

metadata.name: Micron
metadata.description: MU-PERP tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MU) Micron manufactures DRAM and NAND flash memory for data centers, consumer electronics, and industrial systems.

metadata.name: Amazon
metadata.description: AMZN-PERP tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in Amazon.com, Inc. Amazon operates a global e-commerce marketplace and cloud computing platform (AWS), alongside digital media and logistics services.

metadata.name: Google
metadata.description: GOOGL-PERP tracks the value of 1 share of Class A common stock in Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL) Alphabet is the parent company of Google, operating search, advertising, cloud computing, and AI businesses, along with various technology subsidiaries.

metadata.name: Netflix
metadata.description: NFLX references 1 share of Netflix, Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: NFLX), quoted in USD. Netflix provides subscription video entertainment and advertising-supported streaming.

metadata.name: Palantir
metadata.description: PLTR references 1 share of Palantir Technologies Inc. Class A common stock (Nasdaq: PLTR), quoted in USD. Palantir develops data-integration, analytics, and AI software.

metadata.name: SK Hynix
metadata.description: SKHY tracks the value of 1 American depositary share of SK Hynix Inc. (NASDAQ: SKHY). Each ADS represents one-tenth of one share of common stock in SK Hynix (KRX: 000660). SK Hynix manufactures DRAM and NAND memory semiconductors used in data centers, AI hardware, mobile devices, and computing systems.

metadata.name: Apple
metadata.description: AAPL tracks the price of 1 share of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL) common stock. This is a perpetual futures contract cash-settled against the real-time market price of AAPL. Apple designs and sells consumer electronics, software, and services and is one of the world's largest publicly traded companies by market capitalization.

metadata.name: Cloudflare
metadata.description: NET references 1 share of Cloudflare, Inc. Class A common stock (NYSE: NET), quoted in USD. Cloudflare provides cloud-based network, security, and developer services for websites, applications, and internet infrastructure.

metadata.name: Oracle Corporation
metadata.description: ORCL references 1 share of Oracle Corporation common stock (NYSE: ORCL), quoted in USD. Oracle provides database software, enterprise applications, and cloud infrastructure.

metadata.name: Chainlink
metadata.description: Chainlink is a decentralized oracle provider that launched in 2017.

metadata.name: Broadcom
metadata.description: AVGO references 1 share of Broadcom Inc. common stock (Nasdaq: AVGO), quoted in USD. Broadcom provides semiconductors and infrastructure software.

metadata.name: Curve DAO
metadata.description: Curve is an AMM decentralized exchange for swapping similar assets that is built on Ethereum.

metadata.name: TSMC
metadata.description: TSM tracks the value of 1 American depositary share of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC). TSMC is the world's largest dedicated semiconductor foundry, manufacturing advanced chips for global technology companies.

metadata.name: Qualcomm
metadata.description: QCOM tracks the value of 1 share of common stock in QUALCOMM Incorporated. Qualcomm designs semiconductors and wireless technologies, including Snapdragon mobile processors and modems, and licenses foundational cellular patents used across the smartphone industry.

metadata.name: NVIDIA
metadata.description: NVDA tracks the price of 1 share of NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA) common stock. This is a perpetual futures contract cash-settled against the real-time market price of NVDA. NVIDIA designs graphics processing units (GPUs) and AI computing platforms, with chips powering gaming, data centers, artificial intelligence, and advanced computing applications worldwide.
